items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.288

items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S4812

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the public officers law, in relation
to prohibiting agencies from charging for the process of a FOIL
request made by state and local agencies or the state legislature

 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL : To ensure that branches of the
state government will not charge other branches of the state
government for requesting information under FOIL. This bill would
prohibit State and local agencies from charging one another and the
State Legislature for requesting and receiving a Freedom of
Information Law (FOIL) request.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :  Section one amends Section 87 of
the public officers law by adding a new subdivision 6 that stipulates
that agencies shall not charge other state and local agencies or the
state legislature fees for requests made pursuant to the article.

Section two sets out the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :  Currently, if a member of the State Legislature
FOILs information from a city or State department, then they must pay
the fees related to that request. This transfer of funds around from
one section of government to another is inefficient and unnecessary.
Those doing government-related work should not feel constricted by
unnecessary fees when attempting to gather information from other
parts of the government.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY : None

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS : None

 EFFECTIVE DATE : This act shall take effect immediately.

A.actClause: AN ACT to amend the public officers law, in relation to prohibiting certain agencies from charging for the process of a FOIL request made by state and local agencies or the state legislature
A.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S4812A

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the public officers law, in relation to prohibiting
certain agencies from charging for the process of a FOIL request made
by state and local agencies or the state legislature


 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :
To ensure that branches of the state government or the government of a
city of a population over one million will not charge other branches
of the state government for requesting information under FOIL.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :
Section one amends section 87 of the public officers law by adding a
new subdivision 6 that stipulates that state agencies of a city of a
population over one million shall not charge other state and local
agencies or the state legislature fees for requests made pursuant to
the article related to the official performance of their duties.

Section two sets out the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :
Currently, if a member of the State Legislature FOILs information from
a city or State department, then they must pay the fees related to
that request. This transfer of funds around from one section of
government to another is inefficient and unnecessary.  Those doing
government-related work should not feel constricted by unnecessary
fees when attempting to gather information from other parts of the
government.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
None.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.
